title: The Master Dreamer's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the courses that adds a net woven of dreams and a hold that keeps a foe in a trance.

title: A Treatise on the Deep Dreaming Layer
summary: A treatise on the deep layer of the dream where the sleeper's mind sinks past reach and a foe may be lowered after it.

title: The Twin Pillows Treatise
summary: A treatise on two dreamers lying side by side whose paired sleep lulls a foe and mirrors a strike back to its sender.

title: The Azure Dreaming Compendium
summary: A compendium of the clear sky dream in which the dreamer soars above the foe and lets the foe fall into sleep below.

title: Wind-Sworn Dream Lore
summary: A book of the dream as the wind-sworn keep it with a drowse that rides the breeze and an oath to wake every friend.

title: The Oath of the Quiet Sleep
summary: An oath-book of the hushed and open sleep that teaches the dreamer to still a field of foes and to rest the weary.
